payload.title: Signed-in CLI needs PAPYRUS_TENANT_ID set by hand on a tenant site
payload.description: papyrus editorial context on Machines on Machines fails with: Editorial record tenant does not match the configured authoring scope. It works only with PAPYRUS_TENANT_ID=machines-on-machines, and nothing tells the user that value. papyrus login <site> should be enough. The site's public login file does not publish the tenant. Same theme as PPY-83e413, which needs PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT set by hand.
